title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.
tldr: 提出VODA，用局部深度聚类直接监督所有高斯，提升3D高斯分割的体积完整性。
motivation: 现有3D高斯分割主要依赖渲染视图训练与评估，渲染掩码准确并不代表3D选择完整；alpha混合特征监督偏向主要贡献高斯，遮挡或低贡献高斯监督不足。
method: VODA是一种即插即用的监督目标：利用局部深度结构将逐像素贡献高斯分组，并对所选深度簇内所有高斯直接监督，绕过按贡献加权的梯度传递；同时提出Removal-3D基准和RDE指标评估体积完整性。
result: 在四个基于渲染的基线方法上，VODA在Removal-3D上持续提升体积分割，并在LERF和ScanNet上保持或提升性能；分析表明其能恢复低贡献高斯，而简单梯度重加权和空间传播无法复现同等增益。
conclusion: VODA揭示了渲染掩码与3D对象选择之间的监督错配，提供了直接监督所有贡献高斯的通用目标，并给出体积完整性评测基准与指标；有望提升3D高斯分割在对象编辑与移除中的可靠性。

title: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
abstract: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.
tldr: Déjà-Events 通过蒸馏 RGB 教师模型并引入稀疏感知自适应门控，实现事件相机多视图深度、位姿与点图预测。
motivation: 事件相机能在传统相机模糊或饱和的场景中持续捕捉结构，适合快速或弱光环境下的 3D 感知；但带稠密 3D 真值的事件数据集远少于前馈 3D 重建模型所用图像集合且多样性不足。研究旨在不依赖稀缺 3D 标签的情况下，实现事件相机多视图 3D 几何预测。
method: 提出仅用事件的 Déjà-Events 模型，单次前向从多视图预测深度、相机位姿和点图；在配对 RGB 与事件记录上，将冻结的 RGB 教师模型 Déjà View 的最终 token 作为蒸馏目标，无需深度或位姿真值且仅训练约 1% 参数。针对事件在边缘和运动纹理处稠密、无纹理区域稀疏的特点，引入稀疏感知自适应门控，按事件密度逐 patch 调整共享 transformer 块的门控，使增加 refinement 步骤时仍保持精度。
result: 仅用仿真数据训练，Déjà-Events 在 EventScape 上取得所评估事件方法中最低的点图误差，并在真实 MVSEC 和 DSEC 上零样本取得最低点图误差；在 DSEC 上将最强基线 AbsRel 误差减半（0.15 vs. 0.30），参数量约为其十分之一。它还在 EventScape 和 DSEC 上取得最低深度误差，并在 EventScape 上取得最低轨迹误差。
conclusion: 该工作表明可通过 RGB 教师蒸馏与稀疏感知门控，构建低参数、少标签依赖的事件相机前馈多视图 3D 几何模型，并在仿真训练后零样本泛化到真实数据集。其贡献在于缓解事件 3D 数据稀缺问题，为快速或弱光场景下的事件式 3D 感知提供了有效路线。

title: QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.
tldr: QuantileGS 通过分位数学习与尺度归一化保形校准，为 3DGS 新视角渲染误差提供空间自适应的有限样本覆盖上界。
motivation: 新视角合成中渲染可靠性取决于渲染颜色与真实颜色的差异，但无真值图像时该差异不可直接测量；学习得到的误差上界可能低估误差并高估可靠性，因此需要校准到预设覆盖水平。
method: 提出后处理框架 QuantileGS，包含三阶段：在冻结 3DGS 模型上计算 RGB 平均绝对误差；为每个高斯学习两个标量属性以预测渲染误差的上下分位数；在留出图像上用分位数间隔缩放校正项进行尺度归一化保形校准，从而得到空间自适应误差上界并具备有限样本边际覆盖保证。
result: 在名义覆盖率 90% 下，校准将 LLFF 的平均经验测试覆盖率从 69.6% 提升到 89.6%，将 Mip-NeRF 360 从 80.1% 提升到 92.1%；在 LF 上覆盖率保持保守，校准前后分别为 96.3% 和 96.4%。
conclusion: QuantileGS 为 3DGS 渲染误差提供经过校准的空间自适应上界，并在给定假设下保证有限样本边际覆盖；这些上界可用于主动视角选择、高斯剪枝和 RGB-D 同步定位与建图等下游决策。

title: Body of Evidence: Triangulating 3D Human Pose with Geometry-Conditioned Depth
abstract: Even in multi-camera setups, occlusions can leave individual body joints with only a single usable 2D observation. Such an observation defines a viewing ray but leaves the joint's depth undetermined. We introduce Body of Evidence (BoE), a multi-view 3D human pose estimator that predicts per-camera joint depths alongside 2D joint locations. To reduce monocular depth ambiguity, we propose geometry-conditioned depth prediction, which combines image features with previously reconstructed 3D body geometry as contextual depth cues. We further introduce learnable depth-aware triangulation (LDAT), which augments differentiable algebraic triangulation with predicted depth constraints, enabling reconstruction even from a single contributing camera while preserving the benefits of geometric triangulation when multiple views are available. The reconstructed 3D poses subsequently guide depth prediction in the next iteration, allowing depth estimates and 3D geometry to progressively refine each other. Experiments on CMU Panoptic demonstrate state-of-the-art in-domain performance and superior average performance across evaluated camera subsets and unseen camera arrangements. BoE is particularly effective under sparse camera coverage, outperforming the previous state of the art by 10.6 AP25 points in the challenging three-camera setting.
tldr: BoE通过几何条件深度预测与可学习深度感知三角化，在稀疏视角和遮挡下实现鲁棒的3D人体姿态估计。
motivation: 在多相机设置中，遮挡常使部分人体关节只有单个可用的2D观测，而该观测只定义一条视线，无法确定关节深度。单目深度预测本身存在深度歧义，因此需要一种能在仅单相机贡献时仍可靠重建3D关节的方法。
method: 提出Body of Evidence（BoE）多视角3D人体姿态估计器，为每个相机同时预测关节深度与2D位置。几何条件深度预测把图像特征与已重建的3D人体几何结合，作为上下文深度线索以缓解单目深度歧义；可学习深度感知三角化（LDAT）在可微代数三角化中引入预测深度约束，使单相机也可重建，并在多视角可用时保留几何三角化的优势。重建的3D姿态再引导下一轮深度预测，使深度估计与3D几何迭代互增强。
result: 在CMU Panoptic上取得域内state-of-the-art，并在所评估的相机子集与未见相机布局上取得更优的平均性能。在稀疏相机覆盖下优势尤为明显，三相机设置中比先前state-of-the-art高出10.6 AP25。
conclusion: BoE表明深度预测与几何三角化可以互补并通过迭代互相精炼，从而在遮挡和稀疏视角下稳健重建3D人体姿态。该工作为多视角人体姿态估计提供了新思路，对相机覆盖受限的实际场景具有潜在价值。

title: Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments
abstract: The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.
tldr: MomentPnP利用四阶以内14个置换不变矩实现无对应相机位姿估计，并显著降低旋转误差。
motivation: 盲PnP需要在2D-3D点对应未知时估计标定相机位姿；现有学习型方法在无对应和离群点场景下旋转误差较大。作者寻求一种无需学习、对置换不变且能利用点集整体统计量的位姿初始化与优化方法。
method: 提出MomentPnP：在无噪声完整观测下，用最多四阶的14个置换不变图像矩刻画固定相机位姿（3D点集至少20点），通过匹配观测2D点与投影3D点的矩来无对应初始化位姿，再用EM迭代优化位姿和对应权重。
result: 在三个基准测试集上，无论有无离群点，中位旋转误差比最佳学习基线降低5–170倍；即使离群点数量与内点相当仍能恢复准确位姿；在密集ETH3D扫描中，点集增大时位姿精度提升，尽管单点对应更难分辨。
conclusion: MomentPnP表明矩匹配可作为无对应盲PnP的有效且免学习方案，兼顾精度与离群鲁棒性，并为密集点云位姿估计提供新思路。

title: VA-Assembly: View-Aligned Score Guidance for Training-Free 3D Part Assembly
abstract: Image-to-3D foundation models have improved 3D reconstruction, but typically produce monolithic representations without explicit part-level structure. Part-aware generation and learning-based assembly methods often require part-level supervision, category-specific priors, or paired part-layout training data. We instead consider a practical but underexplored setting in which independently prepared or generated 3D parts have no predefined inter-part relationships, shared coordinate frames, or consistent scales, and must be assembled into a reference-consistent object from a single image. We present VA-Assembly, a training-free framework for 3D part assembly through part-level transformation estimation using view-aligned diffusion guidance. Given a reference image and fixed 3D part geometries, VA-Assembly optimizes each part's translation, rotation, and scale. We condition a frozen view-conditioned diffusion model on same-view renderings of a reference-derived monolithic 3D representation, producing score gradients geometrically aligned with the part configuration. This guidance provides multi-view structural cues under large initial misalignment. By repurposing pretrained visual-structural priors as transformation-level supervision, VA-Assembly requires no annotated part layouts, predefined part taxonomies, category-specific assembly training, or bounding-box-based layout initialization. Experiments compare VA-Assembly with geometric registration and compositional layout baselines using each baseline's supported transformation components, showing improved part-wise transformation estimation. Ablation studies show that view-aligned conditioning, rather than diffusion guidance alone, is critical for reliable transformation gradients. Updating only part transformations preserves explicit component separability and supports component-level editing, replacement, and reconfiguration.
tldr: VA-Assembly利用视图对齐扩散引导，在无训练条件下从单图优化部件变换完成3D部件装配。
motivation: 现有多数图像到3D基础模型输出整体表示，缺少显式部件结构；部件感知生成与学习式装配依赖部件级监督、类别先验或成对部件布局训练数据。本文关注更实际但少被探索的设置：独立准备或生成的部件没有预定义相互关系、共享坐标系或一致尺度，却需依据单张参考图装配成一致物体。
method: VA-Assembly是免训练框架，给定参考图与固定部件几何，直接优化每个部件的平移、旋转和缩放。它用参考图导出的整体3D表示在同视角下的渲染图条件化冻结的视图条件扩散模型，获得与部件配置几何对齐的分数梯度，从而在多视角下提供大初始错位时的结构线索。该方法将预训练视觉-结构先验复用为变换级监督，无需部件布局标注、预定义部件分类、类别专用装配训练或基于包围盒的布局初始化。
result: 实验与几何配准及组合布局基线在各自支持的变换分量上比较，显示VA-Assembly在部件级变换估计上更优。消融表明，可靠变换梯度关键来自视图对齐条件化，而非仅使用扩散引导。
conclusion: VA-Assembly证明可将预训练扩散模型的视觉-结构先验作为免训练装配的变换监督，并仅更新部件变换以保留显式部件可分性，支持部件级编辑、替换与重配置。其贡献在于面向无布局先验的3D部件装配提出实用框架，并揭示视图对齐条件化的重要性。

title: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
abstract: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.
tldr: 提出GLPA以轻量全局代理实现跨视角注意力，在保持多视图一致性的同时显著加速并提升3D重建质量。
motivation: 单图生成一致的多视角RGB与法线图可为3D重建提供外观和几何线索，但跨视角一致性依赖视角间信息交换，稠密跨视角注意力随视角数和分辨率增长而计算昂贵。论文旨在降低跨视角通信成本，同时保留视角内细粒度处理。
method: 提出Global-Local Proxy Attention（GLPA）：在每个视角内保留全分辨率交互，跨视角仅通过紧凑的全局代理通信；并引入迭代代理精炼，在单次去噪步内从更新后的特征重建代理并复用同一套注意力参数进行后续交互。
result: 在FLUX上，GLPA相较稠密注意力将每去噪步注意力计算加速2.65倍，重建IoU从0.6849提升至0.7019，NVS LPIPS从0.086降至0.076；在Stable Diffusion上取得1.80倍注意力加速，且五项质量指标均有提升。
conclusion: GLPA以全局代理和迭代精炼有效降低跨视角注意力开销，在提升多视图生成与3D重建质量的同时实现显著加速，并在两种结构不同的扩散骨干上验证了通用性。

title: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
abstract: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.
tldr: OrthoMark 用极坐标频谱检索候选、点锚定高度柱验证，无需训练即可高效完成 LiDAR 位置识别。
motivation: LiDAR 位置识别为 SLAM 提供回环约束，但重力对齐扫描沿垂直方向的高度信息受传感器垂直视场与距离影响：近处结构被截断，导致高度作全局描述子会产生歧义，因此需要一个既能旋转平移不变检索、又能利用高度精细验证的方法。
method: 提出免训练方法 OrthoMark，遵循“两帧扫描只能通过由同一几何表面计算的特征比较”的原则：先用 BEV 的极坐标傅里叶频谱（每关键帧仅 1.9 KB）做平移旋转不变的候选检索，再用相位相关估计平面位姿，并用点锚定高度柱打分——每个 BEV 栅格保存其自身回波的 16 位高度掩码，同一会话内按两帧距离推算的感知范围期望重叠度加权。
result: 在 KITTI 开发序列上，OrthoMark 在无需 3D 配准的免训练方法中取得最高 AP；在多机器人序列上以 RING++ 描述子 1/350 的尺寸达到或超过其表现，并在所有测试中比学习式 BEVPlace++ 闭合更多跨机器人回环。
conclusion: 实验表明高度信息在验证阶段收益显著、在检索阶段反而有害，验证了“同源几何表面特征比较”原则的有效性；该方法以极小描述子、免训练、免 3D 配准实现了强竞争力的多机器人位置识别性能。

title: A Gaussian Primitive Data Management Framework for Efficient 3DGS Trajectory Rendering
abstract: Trajectory rendering, which renders novel views of a reconstructed 3D scene along a camera path, is a core operation in digital twins and autonomous inspection. Structured 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) renders a single view in real time by decoding sparse anchors into Gaussians on demand, but it renders a trajectory view by view: every view projects all anchors to select them, re-decodes anchors already requested by neighboring views, and runs all steps on the GPU while the CPU idles. We treat this as a spatial data management problem, where anchors are spatial objects, views are range queries, and decoded Gaussians are shared derived data, and propose GDM-GS, which removes redundancy at three levels. Within a view, an anchor index and an occluder index answer each view as a holed-frustum range query, so out-of-view and provably hidden anchors are never decoded. Across views, shared materialization decodes each requested anchor once per group of consecutive views while preserving each view's selection. Across processors, a hybrid pipeline balances selections between the CPU and the GPU before grouped decoding under bounded memory. Experiments on large-scale public scenes show that GDM-GS substantially reduces trajectory rendering latency while preserving image quality.
tldr: GDM-GS将3DGS轨迹渲染建模为空间数据管理问题，通过视图内索引、跨视图共享物化与CPU-GPU混合流水线降低冗余。
motivation: 结构化3DGS轨迹渲染逐视图执行，每帧都投影全部锚点并重复解码邻帧已请求锚点，且所有步骤集中在GPU而CPU空闲，造成显著冗余和延迟。论文旨在将轨迹渲染视为空间数据管理问题，系统性消除视图内、跨视图和跨处理器三个层面的冗余。
method: GDM-GS把锚点视为空间对象、视图视为范围查询、解码后的高斯视为共享派生数据。视图内使用锚点索引和遮挡物索引执行带孔视锥范围查询，避免解码视外及可证明隐藏的锚点；跨视图采用共享物化，在连续视图组内每个被请求锚点只解码一次并保持各视图选择；跨处理器通过混合流水线在有限内存下将选择任务在CPU与GPU间均衡后再分组解码。
result: 在大规模公开场景上的实验表明，GDM-GS显著降低轨迹渲染延迟，同时保持图像质量；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GDM-GS通过空间数据管理视角在视图内、跨视图和跨处理器三个层面消除冗余，为3DGS轨迹渲染提供了高效的数据管理框架。其方法对数字孪生和自主巡检等需要沿相机路径渲染新视图的应用具有潜在影响。

title: Pointillist Maize: 3D Reconstruction of Field-Grown Maize Using RGB UAV Imagery
abstract: Three-dimensional reconstruction can extend field phenotyping to individual maize organs, but thin, flexible, occluding structures and plant movement complicate reconstruction. We evaluated whether consumer-grade UAV RGB video processed with Structure from Motion and multi-view stereo could recover recognizable field-grown maize structures, and examined the effects of acquisition trajectories and frame sampling. COLMAP reconstructions preserved recognizable leaves, stems, tassel branches, ears, silks, and brace roots. For an equal-frame comparison, we reconstructed one plant from two sets of 295 frames from the same video: a single orbit sampled at 5 frames/second and three orbits at different altitudes (ribbon skirt) sampled at 2 frames/second. After ground removal, the reconstructions contained 520,601 and 375,318 points, respectively. The single orbit yielded greater point concentration within plant structures and fewer visible gaps, while the ribbon skirt yielded fewer scattered points and slightly lower proportions of isolated points. In densely planted nursery rows, visible voids occupied 17.57% of the rendered scene with one orbit at 1 frame/second, decreasing to 5.07% with additional serpentine passes and 2.68% when the original orbit was sampled at 3 frames/second. Additional observations also increased point dispersion associated with plant movement. A curlicue trajectory tested in a different field in 2024 produced distinguishable individual plants without visible duplicated structures, although substantial voids remained, mainly on the soil surface. These results demonstrate the feasibility of recovering recognizable maize organs from consumer UAV imagery and reveal trade-offs between acquisition strategies, reconstruction completeness, and point dispersion. Independent geometric validation is still needed before quantitative phenotyping.
tldr: 消费级无人机RGB视频结合SfM/MVS可重建田间玉米可识别器官，但采集轨迹与帧采样在完整性和点分散间存在权衡。
motivation: 三维重建有望将田间表型分析拓展到玉米单器官水平，但细长柔韧且相互遮挡的器官以及植株运动使重建困难。研究旨在评估消费级无人机RGB视频经SfM与多视图立体重建后能否恢复可识别的田间玉米结构，并分析采集轨迹和帧采样的影响。
method: 使用消费级无人机RGB视频，经Structure from Motion与多视图立体（COLMAP）重建田间玉米。等帧数比较中，从同一视频取295帧分别构建单轨道5帧/秒与三高度“ribbon skirt”2帧/秒重建；在密集苗行中比较单轨道1帧/秒、增加蛇形航次及原轨道3帧/秒，并测试2024年不同田块的curlicue轨迹。
result: 重建保留了可识别的叶片、茎、雄穗分枝、果穗、花丝和支柱根；等帧数下两种重建去地面后分别含520,601和375,318个点，单轨道在植株结构内点更集中且可见空隙更少，ribbon skirt散点更少且孤立点比例略低。密集苗行中单轨道1帧/秒可见空洞占渲染场景17.57%，增加蛇形航次降至5.07%，原轨道3帧/秒降至2.68%；额外观测也因植株运动增加点分散。2024年curlicue轨迹可区分单株且无明显重复结构，但仍有较大空洞，主要位于土壤表面。
conclusion: 研究表明消费级无人机影像可恢复可识别的玉米器官，并揭示采集策略、重建完整性与点分散之间的权衡。在用于定量表型前仍需独立的几何验证。

title: Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
abstract: Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. Temporal Segment Fusion (TSF) aligns temporal contexts across granularities to capture both short- and long-range motion patterns. Hierarchical Cross-Attention (HCA) promotes spatiotemporal interaction between granularities, and Keyframe Attention (KFA) selects informative motion segments to reduce redundancy and computational cost. Experiments demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structure-aware multi-granularity modeling for monocular 3D human pose estimation.
tldr: 提出结构感知多粒度时空Transformer，利用关键帧注意力降低冗余，实现高效单目3D人体姿态估计。
motivation: 现有多粒度单目3D人体姿态估计方法侧重空间关节特征，未充分利用骨骼结构的全局连接性与时序连续性，且对整段帧序列建模计算成本高。
method: 提出结构感知多粒度时空Transformer，构建联合、骨骼、肢体三级特征提取器以捕获人体拓扑。GASA将结构约束嵌入空间注意力，MGFE通过分层池化与融合增强局部细节和全局语义，TSF对齐多粒度时序上下文，HCA促进跨粒度时空交互，KFA选择信息量高的运动片段以降低冗余和计算量。
result: 实验表明该方法相较传统Transformer方法在精度和效率上均有提升，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明结构感知的多粒度建模能有效提升单目3D人体姿态估计的准确性与效率，为兼顾精度与计算成本提供新思路。

title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
abstract: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.
tldr: SPEED+上单目位姿估计的仿真到真实迁移存在过度自信、非对称迁移与光照方向性增益。
motivation: 轨道视觉导航缺乏真实在轨标注图像，只能主要依赖合成图像训练，而SPEED+等基准所用模拟器在迈拉/铝材反射建模上存在辐射度误差，导致存在镜面高光、硬阴影和传感器饱和等合成到真实差距。该文旨在探测这一差距对单目位姿估计可靠性的风险。
method: 作者采用刻意简单的单目位姿估计器，在SPEED+上开展2x2研究，联合考察主干网络适配与光度增强，训练用合成图像、测试用sunlamp和lightbox两个真实硬件在环域，并分析共形校准覆盖率；所有评审后实验均预注册。
result: 合成数据上共形校准到90%的区域仅覆盖真实旋转误差的9–15%（sunlamp）和21–38%（lightbox）；扩大数据与特征使合成旋转误差从1.65降至1.03 rad，但sunlamp仅改善0.05 rad，低于两倍种子标准差；适配主干最后阶段可将63–83%的额外合成增益迁移到两个真实域。光度增强使lightbox从1.17降至0.99 rad且每个种子均有效，但对sunlamp不超过种子间波动，冻结主干时反而对sunlamp更有效。
conclusion: 模拟器误设定会导致模型对错误位姿给出与正确位姿相似的置信度，且迁移收益具有非对称性和光照方向性。主干适配比单纯扩大数据/特征更具跨域可迁移性，光度增强只在所建模的光照方向上有效；该预注册研究为航天器位姿估计的鲁棒性评估提供了可复现代码、逐图预测和实验记录。

title: CiGS: Conduction in Gaussian Splats for Interior Temperature Field from Thermal Images
abstract: We present a method for inferring the interior temperature distribution of a solid object from registered multi-view visible-spectrum and thermal images, even when the thermal views cover only part of its surface. We formulate steady-state heat conduction as a Laplace boundary value problem and solve it with a direct boundary integral equation discretized over a point cloud: a Gaussian reconstruction of the visible-spectrum images supplies the boundary geometry, and the thermal images supply the boundary data. We do not build surface or volume meshes at any stage in our method. Instead, we sample collocation points from rendered depth without the pixels at depth discontinuities, and use a density subtraction that keeps the interior evaluation accurate up to the surface. The whole chain is differentiable, and we use it to recover the pose and depth of heating pipes, insulation defects, and the shape of cracks from thermal images. We validate our method through experiments on boundary value problems with Dirichlet-only and mixed Dirichlet and Robin boundaries, using synthetic and real captured data on scenes with challenging topology. These experiments show that our method matches analytical solutions and has better accuracy than FEM solvers.
tldr: 利用高斯泼溅几何与热像边界数据，直接求解拉普拉斯边界积分方程，无需网格即可推断物体内部温度场。
motivation: 从配准的多视角可见光与热红外图像推断固体内部温度分布，即使热像仅覆盖部分表面；同时避免构建表面或体网格，以提升复杂拓扑场景下的适用性与精度。
method: 将稳态热传导建模为拉普拉斯边值问题，并在点云上离散直接边界积分方程；可见光图像的高斯重建提供边界几何，热像提供边界数据。方法从渲染深度采样配点并剔除深度不连续像素，采用密度减除以保持近表面内部评估精度，且全链路可微，可用于反演加热管位姿与深度、保温缺陷及裂纹形状。
result: 在仅Dirichlet及混合Dirichlet-Robin边界条件的边值问题上，使用合成与真实采集的复杂拓扑场景数据验证；结果与解析解一致，且精度优于FEM求解器。摘要未提供具体量化数值指标。
conclusion: 提出一种无网格、可微的内部温度场推断框架，将高斯泼溅几何与热像边界数据结合到边界积分方程中；其精度超过FEM并支持从热像反演隐藏结构与缺陷，具有用于无损检测、建筑保温评估等潜力。

title: AstroPIE-53: Towards Understanding Failure Modes of Human Pose Estimation in Space
abstract: Reliable monitoring of astronauts is essential for safety, situational awareness, and autonomous assistance in space missions. While modern computer vision enables accurate human detection and pose estimation on Earth, its robustness in space environments remains largely unquantified due to limited data availability. We present AstroPIE-53, a pilot dataset of 53 annotated astronaut videos collected from publicly available mission footage. To respect copyright restrictions, we release video identifiers, reconstruction scripts, and dense annotations rather than raw videos. The dataset includes bounding boxes, challenge classes, and human-annotated pose failure tags. We benchmark state-of-the-art person detection and pose estimation models under realistic zero-shot deployment conditions and perform the first systematic failure analysis for astronaut monitoring. Our results reveal substantial performance degradation caused by occlusions, unusual body orientations, low contrast, and microgravity motion patterns.
tldr: 发布53段航天员视频数据集AstroPIE-53，系统评估太空环境下人体姿态估计的零样本失效模式。
motivation: 太空任务中航天员可靠监测对安全、态势感知和自主辅助至关重要，但现有地球场景视觉模型在太空环境中的鲁棒性因数据稀缺而缺乏量化。
method: 构建AstroPIE-53飞行员数据集，包含53段公开任务视频的标注；因版权限制仅发布视频标识、重建脚本与密集标注（边界框、挑战类别、人工姿态失败标签）。在真实零样本部署条件下基准测试先进人体检测与姿态估计模型，并开展首个面向航天员监测的系统失效分析。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但报告先进模型性能显著下降，主要失效由遮挡、异常身体朝向、低对比度和微重力运动模式引发。
conclusion: 该工作揭示太空环境下人体姿态估计的关键失效模式，为航天员监测模型的鲁棒性评估与后续改进提供数据和基准。

title: See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light
abstract: Galaxies evolve over hundreds of millions of years, and no telescope has ever watched one move. Cosmological simulations make this evolution visible as a sequence of multi-view images, inviting the question of whether a galaxy can be recovered in four dimensions from its images. This setting defeats existing dynamic scene methods, since millions of stars span only a few pixels each, faint populations blend into diffuse light, and free deformations reproduce the images without obeying gravity. We present Cosmos4D, which rests on two components. Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting represents each star as a self-luminous Gaussian whose motion is integrated through a gravitational potential and a low-dimensional force field shared by all stars. Luminosity-stratified dynamics give bright stars individual orbits supervised across image scales and carry faint populations with a velocity field estimated from optical flow. We further build a 4D dataset of eight galaxies from four cosmological simulations, on which Cosmos4D outperforms dynamic Gaussian baselines in both photometric quality and physical accuracy. With these advancements, we glimpse eight hundred million years of a galaxy's life in ninety-six frames.
tldr: Cosmos4D 用引力约束的4D高斯泼溅从多视角图像重建星系演化。
motivation: 星系演化跨越数亿年，望远镜无法直接观测其运动；宇宙学模拟以多视角图像序列呈现演化，引出能否从图像四维重建星系的问题。现有动态场景方法难以处理数百万颗仅占少数像素的恒星、弥散暗弱星族，且自由变形虽拟合图像却不遵守引力。
method: 提出 Cosmos4D：引力4D高斯泼溅将每颗恒星表示为自发光高斯，其运动通过引力势与所有恒星共享的低维力场积分得到。亮度分层动力学让亮星拥有可跨图像尺度监督的个体轨道，并用光流估计的速度场带动暗弱星族；同时构建来自四个宇宙学模拟、包含八个星系的4D数据集。
result: 在八个星系的数据集上，Cosmos4D 在光度质量与物理精度上均优于动态高斯基线；以96帧呈现星系约8亿年的生命历程。
conclusion: 表明引力约束与亮度分层动力学可从图像中恢复星系的四维演化，为观测不可及的星系演化提供可视化与物理一致的重建途径。

title: acuSimNet: Multi-View Self-Occlusion-Awared Visibility Learning for Cranio-Cervical Acupuncture Points
abstract: The localization of acupuncture points (acupoints) in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) presents unique challenges since they are defined by abstract principles rather than distinct anatomical landmarks. Existing approaches are typically constrained to single view or rely on indirect calculations of relative positions with respect to other landmarks, thereby overlooking human anatomical variations. Furthermore, acupoint visibility assessment, which determins whether points are occluded by human itself, hair, clothing, or other objects, has received limited attention in practical applications. Acupoint localization itself does not require 3D reconstruction, but inferring their occlusion relationships with anatomical surfaces does, which adds computational cost and limits real-time inference. In this work, we introduce acuSimNet, an efficient hierarchical multi-task learning architecture for multi-view, self-occlusion-aware visibility prediction of acupoints, achieving 99.97% accuracy on the validation set. Our approach also addresses the challenges of high-dimensional classification (174 acupoints in cervicocranial region), negative convergence issues for visible acupoints, and inter-task scheduling optimization, resulting in substantially accelerated convergence. We improved the training efficiency from the exisiting methods of 3000 epochs to achieve 99% validation accuracy, to our optimized framework achieving 90% accuracy in 39 epochs and 99% accuracy in 86 epochs. This architecture overcomes the limitations of existing methods, could enable practical applications in acupoints detection and visualization, advancing the automation of TCM.
tldr: 提出acuSimNet，多视角自遮挡感知预测颈颅穴位可见性，验证准确率达99.97%并大幅加速收敛。
motivation: 颈颅部穴位由抽象原则定义而非清晰解剖标志，现有方法多限于单视角或依赖相对位置间接计算，忽略人体解剖差异；同时穴位是否被人体、头发、衣物等遮挡的可见性评估关注不足。穴位定位本身不需三维重建，但推断其与解剖表面的遮挡关系需要三维信息，带来计算开销并限制实时推理。
method: 提出acuSimNet，一种高效的分层多任务学习架构，用于多视角、自遮挡感知的穴位可见性预测。该方法针对174个颈颅部穴位的高维分类、可见穴位的负收敛问题以及任务间调度优化进行设计，从而加速模型收敛。
result: 在验证集上达到99.97%的准确率；训练效率显著提升，从现有方法需3000个epoch达到99%验证准确率，优化框架仅需39个epoch达到90%、86个epoch达到99%准确率。
conclusion: 该架构克服了现有方法在单视角、间接定位和遮挡评估方面的局限，可支持穴位检测与可视化的实际应用，推动中医自动化发展。

title: SemLite-GS: Semantic-Selective Parallel Gaussian Splatting for Lightweight Building Reconstruction from UAV Oblique Imagery
abstract: Lightweight 3D building models support urban spatial analysis, but their production often requires dense scene reconstruction, building extraction, and mesh simplification. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is more efficient than conventional multi-view stereo, existing large-scale methods lack semantic selection and parallel instance-level training. We present SemLite-GS, a building-centric framework that reconstructs lightweight building meshes from large-scale UAV oblique imagery. First, an orthographic reference map establishes globally consistent building identities, which are propagated to oblique views to form camera-instance pairs and regions of interest. Second, semantic-selective parallel PGSR training jointly processes multiple pairs within relevant image regions while updating only target Gaussians; contextual Gaussians remain fixed to preserve visibility. Third, architectural planes extracted from rendered depth, opacity, and normal maps guide signed distance field optimization, producing meshes with adaptive polygon allocation and well-defined structural boundaries. Experiments on multiple large-scale UAV datasets demonstrate that our SemLite-GS substantially reduces building reconstruction time compared with representative full-scene 3DGS methods. With comparable polygon budgets, SemLite-GS achieves superior preservation of dominant planar structures and sharp architectural transitions compared with conventional dense reconstruction followed by mesh decimation. The source code is available at https://github.com/IRIS-LAB-whu/SemLite-GS.
tldr: SemLite-GS通过语义选择与并行PGSR训练，从无人机倾斜影像高效重建轻量建筑网格。
motivation: 轻量建筑模型支撑城市空间分析，但传统流程需密集重建、建筑提取与网格简化，效率较低；现有大规模3DGS方法缺乏语义选择与实例级并行训练。
method: 先用正射参考图建立全局一致的建筑身份并传播至倾斜视图，形成相机-实例对与感兴趣区域；再以语义选择式并行PGSR仅更新目标高斯、固定上下文高斯，并利用渲染深度、不透明度与法线提取建筑平面引导SDF优化，实现自适应多边形分配与清晰结构边界。
result: 在多个大规模无人机数据集上，SemLite-GS相较代表性全场景3DGS方法显著缩短建筑重建时间；在相当多边形预算下，其主导平面结构保持与建筑锐利过渡效果优于密集重建后网格简化流程。
conclusion: 该工作提出面向建筑轻量化重建的语义选择并行高斯泼溅框架，兼顾重建效率与结构保真度，并开源代码，具有城市三维建模应用潜力。

title: Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.
tldr: 提出免训练查询驱动的Gaussian Splatting三维实例分割框架，实现高效开放词汇分割。
motivation: 开放词汇3D理解需定位并分割预定义类别之外的任意物体，但现有基于Gaussian Splatting的方法依赖昂贵预处理和冗长训练，难以满足快速、轻量需求。
method: 提出免训练的查询驱动3D实例分割框架：放弃mask-wise CLIP嵌入，改用稠密像素级CLIP特征保留细粒度语义并支持文本驱动定位；针对文本查询在精选pivot view中定位高质量目标区域，经视频分割器跨视角传播获得2D tracklets，再通过可见性投票策略提升为3D Gaussian掩码。
result: 在LERF-OVS、ScanNet和ScanNet++上取得SOTA，在3D-OVS上取得有竞争力结果，并较现有开放词汇3D分割方法显著加速；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
conclusion: 该工作证明无需逐场景训练也能在Gaussian Splatting上实现高效、边界清晰的开放词汇3D实例分割，为轻量快速3D场景理解提供了新路线。

title: DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images
abstract: Omnidirectional ($360^\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/BurakSevsay/DEFDVO
tldr: DEFDVO 提出面向 ERP 全景图像的块级深度视觉里程计，通过可变形特征与接缝感知显著降低轨迹误差。
motivation: 全景相机视场大，但 ERP 投影带来纬度相关畸变、图像边界接缝和极区采样偏置，现有 360° 视觉里程计方法只能部分解决这些问题。
method: DEFDVO 直接在 ERP 图像上执行基于图像块的深度视觉里程计：融合球面几何先验与可学习采样偏移的可变形特征提取，端到端接缝感知处理保持 ERP 连续性，并用球面梯度图像块选择缓解极区采样偏置。
result: 仅在合成 TartanAirV2 ERP 图像上训练，在 360DVO 定义的 TartanAirV2 评测集上将最佳先前方法的平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）从 0.201 m 降至 0.042 m，提升 4.8 倍；在真实世界 360DVO 基准的两个划分上均取得最低平均 ATE。
conclusion: 该方法补齐了 ERP 全景深度 VO 在畸变、接缝和极区偏置处理上的不足，在合成与真实基准上均优于现有方法，为 360° 视觉里程计提供了有效的端到端方案。

title: TetraCoder: Adaptive Tetrahedral Encoding for Neural Fields
abstract: Implicit and explicit representations of geometry are central in computer graphics applications and come with their pros and cons. With surface sampling being faster on explicit representations and spatial queries being faster on implicit representations, finding efficient conversions between them is a highly desirable property. We present TetraCoder, a single resolution hash-free adaptive tetrahedral encoding that links an explicit tetrahedral spatial encoder with an underlying implicit signed distance field (SDF). The resulting hybrid implicit-explicit space is continuous piecewise affine (CPWA) by design, allowing to obtain an exact correspondence between the implicit SDF and the explicit analytic mesh. TetraCoder's design comes with additional perks, in particular: (a) it scales better than multi-resolution encoding methods due to its single resolution optimizable grid, (b) unlike hash-based methods, it is not affected by collisions, (c) it enables fast tetrahedral ray-tracing, geometry and appearance editing, directly through its adaptive tetrahedral scaffold. We demonstrate the versatility of TetraCoder by showing an improvement over state-of-the-art methods on multiple tasks: 2D/3D fitting from images and point clouds, 3D novel view synthesis, 3D reconstruction, and geometry/appearance editing.
tldr: TetraCoder提出无哈希单分辨率自适应四面体编码，将显式四面体网格与隐式SDF精确关联，并在多类重建与编辑任务上优于现有方法。
motivation: 隐式与显式几何表示各有优劣：显式表示表面采样更快，隐式表示空间查询更快，因此需要高效且精确的相互转换。
method: TetraCoder采用单分辨率、无哈希的自适应四面体编码，将显式四面体空间编码器与底层隐式SDF关联，构造连续分段仿射（CPWA）的混合隐式-显式空间，从而在隐式SDF与显式解析网格间建立精确对应。
result: 摘要称在2D/3D图像与点云拟合、3D新视角合成、3D重建及几何/外观编辑等任务上相较SOTA均有提升，但未给出具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该设计避免了多分辨率编码的扩展性问题和哈希碰撞问题，并支持快速四面体光线追踪及直接的几何/外观编辑，为神经场提供统一的隐式-显式表示。

title: Deep Bundle Adjustment
abstract: We present \textbf{DeepBA} (\textbf{Deep} \textbf{B}undle \textbf{A}djustment), a graph neural network (GNN) that recovers camera poses, intrinsics, and scene structure from 2D matches across an arbitrary number of views. Rather than solving a non-linear least-squares problem per scene, DeepBA amortizes bundle adjustment into a learned graph network that iteratively refines its estimate from geometric residuals. Where classical SfM computes its updates analytically and needs careful initialization, DeepBA learns them and converges from a cold start. It is trained with scale-invariant supervision (ground-truth rotation, translation direction, and intrinsics, plus reprojection self-consistency), so datasets with arbitrary metric units can be mixed without per-scene normalization. DeepBA is decoupled from the matcher. At 2.04M parameters, it outperforms prior learned SfM from matches on scene reconstruction and on most pose metrics, is competitive with classical SfM at moderate accuracy thresholds and overtakes it in wall time as the view count grows, and approaches monolithic image-to-geometry transformers such as VGGT ($\sim$1.2B parameters) with greater modularity. Project~page: https://cphjsn.github.io/deep-ba/
tldr: DeepBA 用图神经网络摊销光束法平差，从2D匹配冷启动恢复相机位姿、内参与场景结构。
motivation: 经典SfM需逐场景求解非线性最小二乘，依赖精细初始化；已有学习式SfM常与匹配器耦合。DeepBA旨在将BA摊销为可学习图网络，实现冷启动收敛并解耦匹配器。
method: DeepBA以GNN在任意数量视图的2D匹配上迭代优化几何残差，学习相机位姿、内参与场景结构的更新而非解析求解。训练采用尺度不变监督，包括真值旋转、平移方向、内参与重投影自一致性，使任意度量单位的数据集可混合训练。
result: 仅2.04M参数的DeepBA在场景重建和多数位姿指标上优于已有基于匹配的学习式SfM；在中等等精度阈值下与经典SfM相当，且视图数增加时墙钟时间反超。其性能接近约1.2B参数的VGGT等单体图像到几何Transformer，同时模块化更强。
conclusion: DeepBA表明学习式摊销BA可从冷启动收敛并保持匹配器无关的模块化优势，为可扩展SfM提供了轻量替代方案，并缩小了与大型单体几何Transformer的差距。

title: EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
abstract: Feed-forward multi-view transformers such as VGGT recover the cameras and geometry of a video in one pass, but the cost of their cross-frame attention grows quadratically with the frame count, and their accuracy drops on long videos. Most remedies approximate attention over all frames within a budget or select a few keys by their content. We hypothesize that the keys of a long video can be chosen without looking at its content, and our experiments on VGGT and $π^3$ support it: a few dozen evenly spread frames can serve as the keys of every frame. We present EcoVGGT, a training-free inference framework whose keys form a Pinned Key Set of 31 such frames. A pin pass stores their tokens in a Scene Cache, and the other frames read it in independent batches that reproduce joint inference with these keys exactly, at a constant cost per frame. An Online Stream updates the pinned frames during recording. Six middle global blocks align the frames and form a reusable VGGT module: the Alignment Score reads their attention to flag failures, and Alignment Refocusing reduces them by fine-tuning only these blocks (3.6 GPU hours). EcoVGGT ($π^3$) matches the success rate of $π^3$ on 1,000-frame ScanNet videos at 13.8 times its speed. With refocusing, EcoVGGT (VGGT) raises the success rate of VGGT from 70% to 82% at 8.5 times its speed on 500 frames. EcoVGGT reconstructs 4,000 frames on one GPU, and EcoVGGT ($π^3$) streams 1,000 frames at 18.6 frames per second with the lowest online absolute trajectory error.
tldr: EcoVGGT用31帧固定关键集实现免训练、恒定单帧开销的长视频流式前馈三维重建。
motivation: VGGT等前馈多视图Transformer能一次恢复视频相机与几何，但跨帧注意力开销随帧数二次增长，且长视频精度下降；现有方法多通过预算内近似注意力或按内容挑选少量key来缓解。
method: 作者假设长视频的key无需查看内容即可选取，并在VGGT与π³上验证：均匀分布的几十帧可作为所有帧的key。EcoVGGT由此构建31帧Pinned Key Set，pin pass将其token存入Scene Cache，其余帧分批读取并以恒定单帧成本精确复现联合推理；Online Stream在录制中更新固定帧；6个中间global block组成可复用VGGT模块，Alignment Score读取其注意力以标记失败，Alignment Refocusing仅微调这些块（3.6 GPU小时）。
result: EcoVGGT（π³）在1000帧ScanNet视频上成功率与π³持平，速度提升13.8倍；经refocusing后，EcoVGGT（VGGT）在500帧上把VGGT成功率从70%提升到82%，速度提升8.5倍；单GPU可重建4000帧，EcoVGGT（π³）以18.6 FPS流式处理1000帧并取得最低在线绝对轨迹误差。
conclusion: EcoVGGT是一种免训练、可流式的前馈三维重建推理框架，以固定关键帧集和恒定单帧开销实现长视频高效重建，并通过轻量微调显著降低失败率、提升精度与可扩展性。

title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
tldr: TelePhysica 通过闭环智能体重建可执行物理场景，并用模拟轨迹引导视频扩散生成。
motivation: 直接图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式运动耦合，无法维持持久3D力学平衡、支持中途干预和反事实力控；单次程序化3D重建又因单目深度与支撑间隙欠约束，导致场景穿插或重力坍塌。
method: 视觉语言编码智能体合成可分离视觉网格与声明式物理模型，并通过像素对齐轮廓评审和零力重力平衡预检两阶段验证；验证后的世界编译为统一求解器，耦合刚体、关节链、同维布料壳与3D四面体弹性动力学，模拟推演以像素对齐结构流条件化预训练视频扩散。
result: 在100场景单图基准上，闭环执行将平衡验证世界恢复率从单次合成的0%提升至81%；有限元布料相比刚性板代理产生一个数量级以上局部角位移和面外褶皱；模拟轨迹条件化使动态运动掩码重叠提升2–5倍，并在反事实力反转下保持运动方向，而直接图生视频模型失败。
conclusion: 结果表明，闭环物理重建、统一多物理求解与模拟轨迹条件化可生成可交互、力学一致且支持反事实控制的3D场景与视频，将单图重建推进为可执行物理世界并增强视频生成的物理可控性。

title: MacroGS: Macro-Pixel Shared Gaussian Primitives for Arbitrary-Scale Light Field Super-Resolutio
abstract: Arbitrary-scale light field spatial super-resolution reconstructs high-resolution views at any requested scale from low-resolution multi-view observations. Gaussian primitives enable continuous reconstruction, but generating separate primitive sets for each view redundantly encodes shared scene structure across views and causes the primitive count grow linearly with the number of views. To avoid such redundancy, we propose MacroGS, a feed-forward decoder that jointly predicts a single shared Gaussian set per macro pixel rather than generating separate sets for each view. Disparity-dependent replacement and angle-conditioned appearance allow each set to be reused across all output views, keeping the predicted primitive count independent of the number of views at each requested scale. The decoder iteratively predicts per-primitive disparities, retrieves the corresponding multi-view features, and updates the primitive states. Gaussian splatting and residual refinement then reconstruct the output light field. Despite being learned without geometric supervision, the predicted disparities strongly correlate with underlying scene geometry. Experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that MacroGS integrates effectively with diverse light field encoders, improving reconstruction quality at fixed scales while achieving leading performance across most evaluated arbitrary-scale settings. The decoder also achieves speedups of approximately $2$-$10\times$ over state-of-the-art implicit light field decoders and $10$-$18\times$ over the view-wise Gaussian baseline.
tldr: MacroGS 用逐宏像素共享的高斯基元实现任意尺度光场超分，减少视图冗余并加速重建。
motivation: 任意尺度光场空间超分需要从低分辨率多视图观测重建任意请求尺度的高分辨率视图。现有高斯基元方法虽支持连续重建，但为每个视图单独生成基元集合会冗余编码跨视图共享场景结构，并使基元数量随视图数线性增长。
method: 提出 MacroGS 前馈解码器，在每个宏像素上联合预测单个共享高斯集合，而非逐视图生成独立集合；通过视差相关替换和角度条件外观使该集合可复用于所有输出视图。解码器迭代预测逐基元视差、检索对应多视图特征并更新基元状态，随后用高斯泼溅与残差精修重建输出光场；尽管未使用几何监督，预测视差仍与场景几何强相关。
result: 在五个基准上，MacroGS 可与多种光场编码器有效集成，提升固定尺度重建质量，并在大多数任意尺度设置下取得领先性能；相比先进隐式光场解码器加速约 2-10 倍，相比逐视图高斯基线加速约 10-18 倍。
conclusion: MacroGS 通过宏像素共享高斯表示避免跨视图冗余，使每个请求尺度下的基元数量与视图数无关，为任意尺度光场超分提供了高效且兼容性强的解码方案。该方法在无几何监督下获得与场景几何相关的视差预测，显示出共享基元表示在光场重建中的潜力。

title: Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is prone to overfitting because only a limited number of images are available to constrain scene geometry. Dropout is one regularization strategy for alleviating this problem. We introduce the concept of a lineage family to describe a set of Gaussian primitives derived from the same founder through cloning or splitting operations. The founder Gaussians refer to all Gaussian primitives generated during initialization. Descendants within the same family often jointly contribute to the refinement of adjacent local regions. However, dropping individual Gaussians can be less effective due to the compensation effect from neighboring Gaussians for the dropped ones. To address this issue, we propose Stage-wise Lineage-aware Dropout(SLD), which applies lineage-family dropout during the structural regularization stage and switches to individual dropout during the later refinement stage. We further propose Lineage-Balanced Densification(LBD), which operates during densification by constructing an expanded candidate pool and reallocating the densification budget according to the mean gradient scores and existing descendant sizes of different families. Experiments on the LLFF, MipNeRF360, and Blender datasets show that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in sparse-view reconstruction
tldr: 提出阶段式谱系感知Dropout与谱系平衡致密化，缓解稀疏视角3DGS过拟合。
motivation: 稀疏视角3DGS因可用图像有限、场景几何约束不足而容易过拟合。现有Dropout正则化中，单独丢弃高斯因邻近高斯的补偿作用而效果有限，需要针对同一谱系内高斯的联合贡献进行建模。
method: 定义由同一创始高斯经克隆或分裂得到的谱系家族；提出SLD，在结构正则化阶段执行谱系家族级Dropout，在后续细化阶段切换为个体Dropout；并提出LBD，在致密化时构建扩展候选池，依据不同家族的平均梯度分数和已有后代规模重新分配致密化预算。
result: 在LLFF、MipNeRF360和Blender数据集上的实验表明，该框架在稀疏视角重建中取得有竞争力的性能；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作通过谱系感知的阶段式Dropout和谱系平衡致密化，为稀疏视角3DGS提供了一种针对过拟合与致密化不均衡的正则化框架。其贡献有望提升稀疏输入下三维重建的稳定性与质量。

title: X-Strata: Separating Aneurysms and Overlapping Vessels into Layers from 2D X-ray Angiography
abstract: An X-ray angiogram sums every structure along a ray into one pixel. When vessels cross an aneurysm, they obscure part of it and mix their contrast into its filling curve. We present X-Strata, a network that separates a cine angiogram into three layers: the complete aneurysm sac, the vessels in front of it, and the vessels behind it. Contrast timing indicates how much each layer contributes to a pixel, and parallax between two views indicates their order, which a single view cannot determine. X-Strata first estimates the layers and their contrast curves, then uses the second view to assign vessels to the front or back layer, and lifts all layers into 3D. It learns from layer labels projected from same-session 3D rotational angiography, but needs only 2D cine runs and their acquisition geometry at inference. On 220 held-out patients from three centers (122 external), two-view X-Strata ranks first among 14 baselines, including VGGT and C$^2$RV, in recovering the sac where vessels overlap it (Dice 0.693 internal, 0.641 external) and in ordering the layers (balanced accuracy 0.703, 0.659). Its order accuracy exceeds that of all 11 end-to-end baselines by at least 4.1 points internally and 3.3 externally (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$) and grows with view separation. Recovered 3D sac surfaces have a median Chamfer distance of 0.34 mm on the internal cohort. X-Strata may therefore provide layered aneurysm and vessel information, including 3D sac shape, for patients who undergo only 2D angiography.
tldr: X-Strata 利用双视角造影将动脉瘤与前后血管分层并重建3D瘤囊。
motivation: 2D X 射线血管造影将沿射线方向的所有结构叠加到同一像素，交叉血管会遮挡动脉瘤并将其对比剂混入瘤囊充盈曲线，且单视角无法判断血管位于瘤囊前方还是后方。研究目标是分离动脉瘤囊与重叠血管层，并恢复其空间层次和三维形态。
method: X-Strata 首先从 cine angiogram 估计动脉瘤囊、前方血管和后方血管三层及其对比曲线，再利用第二视角的视差将血管分配到前层或后层，并将各层提升到3D。训练时使用同次3D旋转血管造影投影得到的层标签，推理时仅需2D cine 序列及其采集几何。
result: 在三中心220例留出患者（122例外中心）上，双视角X-Strata在血管重叠区域恢复瘤囊（Dice 0.693内部、0.641外部）和层排序（平衡准确率0.703、0.659）方面于14个基线中排名第一，包括VGGT和C²RV；其层序准确率至少比11个端到端基线高4.1个百分点（内部）和3.3个百分点（外部），Holm校正p<0.001，并随视角间隔增大而提升。内部队列恢复的3D瘤囊表面中位Chamfer距离为0.34 mm。
conclusion: X-Strata 能为仅接受2D血管造影的患者提供分层的动脉瘤与血管信息，包括3D瘤囊形状，有望扩展2D造影在动脉瘤评估中的信息利用能力。

title: Training-Free Acceleration of Multi-View 3D Transformers via Regime-Aware Attention Approximation
abstract: Multi-view 3D transformers such as VGGT reconstruct a scene from a set of unposed images in a single forward pass, predicting camera poses, depth and 3D points, but the cost of their global attention grows quadratically with the num- ber of images. Accelerators borrowed from large language models assume that each token attends to only a few oth- ers; on these models they lose accuracy or gain little speed. We study the global attention of three multi-view transform- ers on seven datasets and find that every layer plays one of three roles: it averages over the whole scene, matches points across many images, or anchors on the first image, whose coordinates the outputs use. Building on this anal- ysis, we propose Regime-AWare ATTention Approximation (RAWATTA), a training-free method that runs attention in 8- bit precision and keeps 16-bit precision only in the layers where a worst-case calibration check requires it. Its fast set- ting, RAWATTA-Fast, also approximates attention in a few averaging and anchoring layers, while matching layers and the first image keep all their keys. On a 12 GB GPU at 50 im- ages, RAWATTA runs VGGT faster than the released code, mostly through our CUDA engine, and loses at most about one point of pose accuracy (AUC@3) on any dataset; RAWATTA-Fast is slightly faster and less accurate. Both fit 200 images, where the released code runs out of memory at 100.
tldr: 提出免训练RAWATTA，按注意力角色混合8/16位近似，加速多视图3D Transformer并支持200图。
motivation: 多视图3D Transformer（如VGGT）的全局注意力随图像数量二次增长，而借用自大语言模型的稀疏注意力加速器在此类模型上要么掉精度要么提速有限。本文旨在免训练地降低该全局注意力开销，同时保持位姿、深度和3D点预测精度。
method: 作者在7个数据集上分析三个多视图Transformer的全局注意力，发现每层承担整场景平均、跨图像点匹配或首图锚定三类角色之一。据此提出RAWATTA：以8位精度运行注意力，仅在最坏情况校准检查要求时保留16位；RAWATTA-Fast进一步在平均与锚定层做近似，而匹配层和首图保留全部key，并用CUDA引擎加速。
result: 在12 GB GPU、50张图像下，RAWATTA比官方代码更快（主要得益于CUDA引擎），在任一数据集上位姿精度AUC@3最多下降约1个点；RAWATTA-Fast略快但精度更低。两者可处理200张图像，而官方代码在100张时已显存不足。
conclusion: 研究表明按注意力角色进行混合精度与结构化近似可在免训练条件下有效加速多视图3D Transformer，并显著扩展可处理图像数量。该方法为高分辨率、大场景多视图3D重建提供了实用加速路径，并提示LLM式稀疏加速需适配3D注意力的层角色。

title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
abstract: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
tldr: BrickFlow通过集合条件SE(3)流模型与连通性场引导，从图像和零件集重建可组装的LEGO结构。
motivation: 给定LEGO零件集与组装物体图像，需推断每个零件的位姿并完成组装。该任务需满足离散物理约束，问题具有组合性且对微小位姿误差高度敏感，传统3D重建难以直接适用。
method: 在程序生成的装配体上训练set-conditioned SE(3) flow model，学习零件如何拼合的先验；再用仅1%的数据微调以注入图像条件；测试时引入解析的connectivity-field guidance，将预测拉向连通的装配体。
result: 实验表明，构建质量随模型规模、预训练和连通性引导的使用而提升；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该方法将学习到的SE(3)流先验与解析连通性引导结合，改善了基于图像的LEGO装配重建质量，并公开模型与数据以促进后续研究。

title: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
abstract: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld. GFM predicts camera parameters, depth, cross-view correspondences, and dynamic 3D points from images and videos. PoseEngine combines these predictions with geometric optimization to recover scene-level camera poses and geometry for downstream 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting. KosmoWorld generates images and geometric supervision from reconstructed real-world scenes to improve GFM's geometric predictions. On the Sparse and Medium subsets of SpatialBench, GFM achieves the lowest absolute relative depth error and the highest relative-pose AUC at 5 degrees among the compared methods. It also achieves the lowest mean endpoint errors for dynamic points and scene flow across the five evaluated datasets. Across 34 scenes completed by all compared reconstruction systems, PoseEngine achieves the highest scene-averaged pose AUC at thresholds of 1, 3, and 5 degrees, with a cumulative runtime of 14.07 hours, approximately 20% of GLUEMAP's 69.67 hours. PoseEngine Flash provides a further accuracy-efficiency trade-off, with a measured mixed-precision runtime of 2.62 hours, approximately 4% of GLUEMAP's runtime. Separate scaling experiments show generally favorable trends with increased data, model computation, and training budgets. These results support the use of learned geometric priors within a scene-level reconstruction pipeline.
tldr: Kosmo-GFM 整合几何基础模型、位姿优化引擎与重建监督，实现高精度高效场景重建。
motivation: 针对场景级三维/四维重建中相机位姿与几何恢复的精度和效率难题，论文提出可生产部署的几何基础模型系统，旨在用学习到的几何先验增强重建流程。
method: GFM 从图像/视频预测相机参数、深度、跨视角对应和动态三维点；PoseEngine 将这些预测与几何优化结合，恢复场景级相机位姿与几何，供 3D/4D Gaussian Splatting 使用；KosmoWorld 从重建的真实场景生成图像与几何监督，反向提升 GFM 的几何预测。
result: 在 SpatialBench 的 Sparse 和 Medium 子集上，GFM 取得最低绝对相对深度误差和最高 5° 相对位姿 AUC；在五个数据集上取得最低动态点与场景流平均端点误差。34 个场景中 PoseEngine 在 1°/3°/5° 阈值下场景平均位姿 AUC 最高，累计运行 14.07 小时，约为 GLUEMAP 69.67 小时的 20%；PoseEngine Flash 混合精度运行 2.62 小时，约为其 4%。
conclusion: 结果表明学习几何先验可用于场景级重建流水线，并在精度与效率间取得优势；系统具备生产可用性，对 3D/4D 重建与 Gaussian Splatting 下游任务有潜在影响。

title: Reconstruct What You Can: Distractor-free 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Dynamic reconstruction from casual video must preserve valid subject motion while suppressing transient occluders, shadows, and volumetric effects. Existing methods either suppress valid motion through static-scene assumptions or model all observations jointly, producing ghosting and unstable geometry. We introduce ReCan-GS, a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework that separates coherent scene content from inconsistent observations. It derives a Jacobian-based deformation-sensitivity score from the learned deformation field, using it as an empirical proxy for reconstruction ambiguity. The score guides separation into dynamic Core Gaussians and per-view Distractor Gaussians, or post-hoc pruning of sensitive Core Gaussians. The same criterion supports removal of spatial occluders, photometric artifacts, and evolving smoke or fog without masks, pretrained segmenters, or medium-specific supervision. Experiments on synthetic and real dynamic scenes and synthetic smoke/fog scenes demonstrate its usefulness across the evaluated distractor regimes.
tldr: ReCan-GS利用形变敏感度分离动态核心与干扰高斯，实现无掩码的干扰物去除4D重建。
motivation: 随意视频的动态重建需保留有效主体运动，同时抑制瞬态遮挡、阴影和体积效应。现有方法要么以静态场景假设压制有效运动，要么联合建模所有观测，导致鬼影和几何不稳定。
method: 提出ReCan-GS 4D高斯泼溅框架，从学习到的形变场推导基于Jacobian的形变敏感度分数，作为重建歧义的经验代理。该分数指导将场景分离为动态Core Gaussians与逐视图Distractor Gaussians，或对敏感Core Gaussians进行事后剪枝；同一准则无需掩码、预训练分割器或介质特定监督即可去除空间遮挡、光度伪影及演化烟雾/雾。
result: 在合成与真实动态场景以及合成烟雾/雾场景上的实验表明，该方法在所评估的干扰物情形下具有有效性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: ReCan-GS通过形变敏感度统一分离一致场景内容与不一致观测，为无需额外掩码和预训练分割器的鲁棒4D重建提供了新思路。其潜在影响在于提升随意视频动态重建对多种干扰物的适应性与几何稳定性。

title: GOOSELoc: A Multimodal Benchmark for Ground-to-Aerial Localization in Unstructured Off-Road Terrain
abstract: Cross-view pose estimation estimates a ground camera's geographic pose by matching onboard sensor data with geo-referenced overhead imagery. This is particularly relevant when GNSS is unreliable, for example under forest canopy or in urban canyons. Existing metric cross-view benchmarks, such as VIGOR and cross-view KITTI, are dominated by urban and road scenes with strong human-made structure without off-road terrain. We introduce GOOSELoc, a multimodal benchmark for ground-to-aerial localization in unstructured environments, including forests, fields, and rural tracks. GOOSELoc comprises 9,356 scenes recorded across all four seasons around Munich, Germany, pairing geo-referenced aerial orthophotos with surround-view RGB imagery and 3D LiDAR point clouds. Paved/unpaved labels enable analyzing the impact of terrain structure, while the seasonal recordings allow studying the appearance gap to mostly summer-captured orthophotos. To assess the transferability of existing methods, we adapt and fine-tune four state-of-the-art cross-view localization baselines on GOOSELoc. Despite task-specific fine-tuning, the performance degrades substantially in off-road environments. We therefore propose a multimodal baseline combining surround-view imagery and LiDAR geometry, improving localization performance and providing a stronger reference for future work. Data and baselines are released at https://gooseloc.github.io.
tldr: 提出GOOSELoc非结构化越野地面到空中定位多模态基准，并给出融合环视RGB与LiDAR的基线。
motivation: 现有度量跨视角定位基准多集中于城市和道路等强人造结构场景，缺乏森林、田野和乡村小径等非结构化越野环境；在GNSS不可靠时，此类环境的地面到空中定位需求突出。
method: 构建GOOSELoc基准，包含德国慕尼黑周边四季录制的9,356个场景，配对地理参考航拍正射影像、环视RGB图像和3D LiDAR点云，并提供铺装/非铺装标签以分析地形结构影响及季节外观差异。适配并微调四种先进跨视角定位基线，同时提出融合环视图像与LiDAR几何的多模态基线。
result: 摘要给出9,356个场景、四季覆盖及四种基线微调结果；现有方法即便任务特定微调后在越野环境中性能仍显著下降，所提多模态基线提升定位性能，但未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GOOSELoc补充了非结构化越野地面到空中定位基准，揭示现有方法迁移性不足，并提供更强的多模态参考基线；数据和基线已公开，有望推动鲁棒跨视角定位研究。

title: Topology-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Egocentric Videos
abstract: Reconstructing dynamic scenes and objects from monocular egocentric video is crucial for embodied AI, yet existing 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) approaches struggle with everyday interactions involving topological changes, such as cutting, assembly, opening, or closing. Since 4DGS methods rely on deforming a fixed representation, events that split, merge, or reveal surfaces cause severe visual artifacts. To address this challenge, we introduce TopoEgo, the first benchmark dedicated to topological changes in egocentric video (covering fission, fusion, open, and close), alongside Topo-4DGS, a topology-aware reconstruction method. Topo4DGS jointly models part-level motion and time-varying surface support by assigning independent rigid transformations to interacting parts and dynamically activating or deactivating Gaussians as surfaces appear, disappear, or separate. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Topo-4DGS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art 4DGS approaches across topological changes, especially on post-event frames. Code and data will be made publicly available.
tldr: 提出TopoEgo基准与Topo-4DGS，用部件级刚体运动与高斯动态激活/停用重建含拓扑变化的自我中心视频。
motivation: 单目自我中心视频中的切割、装配、开合等交互会引发分裂、合并或表面显露等拓扑变化；现有4DGS依赖对固定表示的形变，难以处理此类事件并产生严重伪影。
method: 构建首个面向自我中心视频拓扑变化的TopoEgo基准（覆盖fission、fusion、open、close），并提出Topo-4DGS：为交互部件分配独立刚体变换以建模部件级运动，同时随时间动态激活或停用高斯以表达表面的出现、消失与分离。
result: 实验显示Topo-4DGS在多种拓扑变化场景下显著优于当前4DGS方法，事件后帧尤为明显；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作为含拓扑变化的动态场景重建提供了新基准与方法，通过解耦部件运动与时变表面支撑提升重建鲁棒性，对具身AI中的交互理解与仿真具有潜在影响。

title: SCR-Mamba: Skeleton-conditioned Mamba with cross-scale incremental refinement for efficient 3D human pose estimation
abstract: Mamba-based methods for video-based 3D human pose estimation can model long sequences with linear complexity, but their selective state updates usually lack direct exploitation of skeletal relations. Meanwhile, stacking modeling blocks at the full temporal resolution leads to high computational overhead, while compressing the temporal sequence makes it difficult to retain per-frame details. To address these issues, we propose SCR-Mamba, whose core consists of Skeleton-Conditioned State Modeling (SCSM) and Cross-Scale Incremental Refinement (CSIR). SCSM generates a skeleton context from bone connections and left-right symmetry relations and generates the selective parameters of the spatial and temporal branches conditioned on it, so that structural relations are involved in the writing, propagation, and reading of state information. CSIR constructs multi-scale motion representations through content-adaptive aggregation and progressively refines the retained per-frame features with the increments produced by coarse-scale modeling, integrating long-range motion context while reducing full-resolution computation. On Human3.6M with Stacked Hourglass (SH) 2D detections and 243-frame inputs, SCR-Mamba-L achieves 36.8 mm MPJPE (P1) with 7.72 M parameters and 15.10 G MACs, less than 1/7 of the computational cost of StructMamPose-L with similar accuracy; SCR-Mamba-X further reaches 36.6 mm P1 and 30.9 mm P-MPJPE (P2), achieving state-of-the-art performance. On MPI-INF-3DHP, SCR-Mamba-X achieves a percentage of correct keypoints (PCK) of 99.3%, an area under the curve (AUC) of 88.1%, and an MPJPE of 14.2 mm.
tldr: SCR-Mamba通过骨骼条件状态建模与跨尺度增量细化，高效提升视频3D人体姿态估计精度。
motivation: 现有基于Mamba的视频3D人体姿态估计虽能以线性复杂度建模长序列，但其选择性状态更新未直接利用骨骼关系；同时，全时间分辨率堆叠建模块计算开销高，而压缩时间序列又难以保留逐帧细节。
method: 提出SCR-Mamba，核心包括骨骼条件状态建模（SCSM）与跨尺度增量细化（CSIR）。SCSM从骨骼连接和左右对称关系生成骨骼上下文，并以其为条件生成时空分支的选择性参数，使结构关系参与状态信息的写入、传播与读取；CSIR通过内容自适应聚合构建多尺度运动表示，并用粗尺度建模产生的增量逐步细化保留的逐帧特征，在整合长程运动上下文的同时降低全分辨率计算。
result: 在Human3.6M上使用Stacked Hourglass（SH）2D检测和243帧输入时，SCR-Mamba-L取得36.8 mm MPJPE（P1）、7.72 M参数和15.10 G MACs，计算量不足StructMamPose-L的1/7且精度相近；SCR-Mamba-X进一步达到36.6 mm P1和30.9 mm P-MPJPE（P2），取得state-of-the-art性能。在MPI-INF-3DHP上，SCR-Mamba-X取得99.3% PCK、88.1% AUC和14.2 mm MPJPE。
conclusion: SCR-Mamba将骨骼结构先验注入Mamba状态建模，并通过跨尺度增量细化显著降低全分辨率计算，在多个指标上实现高效且领先的3D人体姿态估计性能。

title: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.
tldr: ThermalSplat 是无需位姿/RGB 的稀疏热成像前馈 Gaussian Splatting 通用三维重建框架。
motivation: 热红外成像在搜救与自主导航中很重要，但低纹理和视角相关发射率会使标准位姿估计失败，稀疏视角下 3D Gaussian Splatting 易崩溃；现有热重建方法依赖密集采集、逐场景优化及对齐 RGB-热数据，难以用于纯热、无位姿环境。
method: 提出 ThermalSplat，首个可泛化的前馈 Gaussian Splatting 框架，直接从稀疏热图像重建三维场景，无需已知相机位姿、RGB 引导或逐场景训练；采用 soft census loss 进行亮度不变的结构匹配，并用 boundary structure loss 显式监督温度不连续边界。
result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标；实验表明 ThermalSplat 在稀疏视角下严格优于场景特定热成像 splatting 方法，并且即使对比这些基线在理想密集采集设置下的表现，也能取得更优的感知保真度。
conclusion: ThermalSplat 消除了计算昂贵的逐场景优化，为纯热、无位姿三维重建提供了高效且可泛化的方案，有望推动搜救与自主导航等热红外应用。

title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
abstract: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.
tldr: IncR-3DSGG 仅用带位姿 RGB 图像增量构建三维场景图，训练时用深度监督，推理无需深度传感器。
motivation: 现有三维场景图生成方法在推理阶段依赖深度传感器，用于跨视角实例关联或几何关系计算，限制了在仅 RGB 平台上的部署。本文旨在仅利用带位姿 RGB 图像和视觉 SLAM 提供的相机外参，增量构建度量一致的三维场景图。
method: 提出参数化关系预测器 PRP，从二维视觉特征与二维几何线索估计物体间距离和相对角度，训练时仅使用三维几何监督。将跨视角预测的成对测量通过位姿图优化 PGO 融合，恢复具有度量尺度的三维物体位置，并增量构建全局一致的三维场景图。
result: 在真实数据集 3RScan 上，按 3DSSG 评估协议取得 52.2 平均物体召回率和 30.8 平均谓词召回率，显著高于 MonoSSG 的 27.0 和 17.6；且推理阶段不使用深度或重建几何。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅凭带位姿 RGB 图像即可预测物体间关系并获得具有度量基础的三维物体表示，为无深度传感器平台的增量三维场景图构建提供了可行方案。

title: MatrixSplat: Matrix-Parallel and Feature-Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering on GPUs
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a mainstream representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. However, existing 3DGS rendering pipelines are poorly aligned with modern GPU architectures: depth-sorted alpha compositing introduces strong per-pixel sequential dependencies, limiting parallelism and resulting in scalar FMA-dominated execution that underutilizes high-throughput matrix units such as Tensor Cores. This mismatch becomes more severe for multimodal and semantically enriched 3DGS, where high-dimensional features must be accumulated from millions of Gaussians, leading to rapidly increasing computation and memory costs. We propose MatrixSplat, a matrix-parallel rendering framework for feature-scalable 3DGS on modern GPUs. We first identify the sequential dependency of alpha compositing as a key obstacle to efficient high-dimensional feature rendering, and adopt an order-independent weighted accumulation formulation that transforms feature rendering into matrix-oriented computation. Our framework features three key designs: (i) a tile-based splatting pipeline that maps feature accumulation to warp-level matrix-multiply-accumulate execution on Tensor Cores; (ii) a warp-granularity Gaussian packing strategy that mitigates visibility irregularity and improves feature reuse; and (iii) a lazy channel-batched feature-fetching pipeline that reduces shared-memory pressure, maintains high warp occupancy, and overlaps memory access with matrix execution for high-dimensional features. On Mip-NeRF 360, LERF, and 3D-OVS, MatrixSplat achieves up to 3.8$\times$ speedup over 3DGS and 2$\times$ over TC-GS while maintaining rendering quality and semantic accuracy, and further reduces render-kernel time by up to 36.7$\times$ for high-dimensional features. Integrated into existing fast renderers, it provides an additional 1.69-2.84$\times$ speedup.
tldr: MatrixSplat将3DGS特征渲染转化为矩阵并行计算，在Tensor Cores上实现高维特征可扩展渲染。
motivation: 现有3DGS渲染管线依赖深度排序的alpha合成，导致逐像素强顺序依赖，限制并行度并形成以标量FMA为主的执行模式，难以利用Tensor Cores等高吞吐矩阵单元。对于多模态和语义增强3DGS，需从数百万高斯中累积高维特征，计算与内存开销进一步急剧增加。
method: MatrixSplat采用与顺序无关的加权累积公式，将特征渲染转化为面向矩阵的计算。其核心设计包括：基于tile的splatting管线，将特征累积映射为Tensor Cores上的warp级矩阵乘加执行；warp粒度的高斯打包策略，缓解可见性不规则并提升特征复用；惰性通道分批特征读取管线，降低共享内存压力、维持高warp占用率，并将内存访问与矩阵执行重叠。
result: 在Mip-NeRF 360、LERF和3D-OVS上，MatrixSplat相比3DGS最高取得3.8倍加速，相比TC-GS取得2倍加速，同时保持渲染质量与语义准确率；对于高维特征，渲染内核时间最高降低36.7倍。集成到现有快速渲染器后，还可额外提供1.69-2.84倍加速。
conclusion: MatrixSplat通过矩阵并行与特征可扩展设计，有效将3DGS高维特征渲染对齐到现代GPU矩阵单元，显著提升语义/多模态3DGS渲染效率。其方法可集成至现有快速渲染器，对实时高维特征3DGS应用具有潜在影响。

title: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction Using V-JEPA Features
abstract: Predictive video encoders provide dense visual representations, but adapting them to 3D reconstruction requires accurate depth, camera poses, and cross-view geometry. We study supervised RGB-only multi-view reconstruction using an architecture that combines video-pretrained features, camera estimation, scene aggregation, epipolar transport, and residual pointmaps. Experiments compare global and spatial camera regression with joint relative objectives on CO3D, alongside an independently trained TUM RGB-D model. On 168 CO3D five-view windows, the spatial-camera configuration achieves 29.3% lower absolute trajectory error than the global-camera configuration, but performs worse than identity poses in trajectory error and worse than the global configuration in depth error. The joint relative-objective configuration improves normalized intrinsics error and similarity-aligned Chamfer distance from 0.6447 to 0.5573, but increases raw Chamfer distance from 3.5535 to 4.4374. On 163 indoor windows, camera error is 0.3063 m versus 0.3694 m for identity poses, while depth error is 0.4279 versus 0.2516 for constant median depth. Refinement worsens indoor camera error, and additional experiments show competing depth and pose effects. Overall, the results distinguish representation adaptation, aligned shape, and raw reconstruction, highlighting the need for isolated component and encoder comparisons before attributing reconstruction gains to predictive video pretraining.
tldr: 该文用V-JEPA特征构建RGB多视图重建架构，并在CO3D与TUM上揭示相机配置和联合目标的深度-位姿权衡。
motivation: 预测视频编码器能提供稠密视觉表示，但适配到仅RGB多视图3D重建仍依赖准确深度、相机位姿与跨视图几何。作者希望厘清重建收益究竟来自表示适配、对齐形状还是原始重建，并判断是否可归因于预测视频预训练。
method: 提出一种监督式RGB-only多视图重建架构，融合V-JEPA视频预训练特征、相机估计、场景聚合、极线传输与残差pointmaps。在CO3D上比较全局相机回归、空间相机回归和联合相对目标，并在TUM RGB-D上独立训练模型进行室内验证。
result: 在168个CO3D五视图窗口上，空间相机配置较全局配置绝对轨迹误差低29.3%，但轨迹误差劣于identity poses、深度误差劣于全局配置；联合相对目标将归一化内参误差和相似对齐Chamfer距离从0.6447降至0.5573，却使原始Chamfer距离从3.5535升至4.4374。在163个室内窗口上，相机误差为0.3063 m，优于identity poses的0.3694 m；深度误差为0.4279，劣于constant median depth的0.2516。
conclusion: 结果表明需区分表示适配、对齐形状与原始重建三类指标，并强调在将重建增益归因于预测视频预训练前，应进行隔离的组件与编码器比较。额外实验还显示深度与位姿效果存在竞争，refinement会恶化室内相机误差。

title: FastWild-GS: Minutes-Scale In-the-Wild Gaussian Splatting via Compact Per-Image Appearance Adaptation
abstract: Internet photos of a scene differ in exposure, illumination and transient objects such as passers-by, so one set of Gaussian colours cannot explain all photos (the in-the-wild setting). Recent in-the-wild Gaussian Splatting methods mostly report hours of per-scene optimization. We present FastWild-GS, which describes each photo by a 128-dimensional Photo Appearance Token and a per-channel transform, a scale and an offset applied to the rendered image (six parameters); a small MLP predicts the colour of each Gaussian from this token and a per-Gaussian feature, replacing the spherical-harmonics colour. The same transform is applied to the renders that score Gaussians for densification and pruning, so appearance differences between photos are not counted as reconstruction error. On PhotoTourism, FastWild-GS trains in 8.8 minutes per scene with the lowest LPIPS among the compared methods, 23x faster than AsymGS, the next best in LPIPS. On NeRF-OSR, it has the best average PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS among the compared methods in 9.7 minutes per scene.
tldr: FastWild-GS用128维图像外观令牌和6参数逐通道变换建模照片外观，在PhotoTourism和NeRF-OSR上以分钟级训练取得最低LPIPS或最佳综合指标。
motivation: 互联网照片存在曝光、光照和行人等瞬态物体差异，单一高斯颜色无法解释所有照片；现有野外高斯泼溅方法通常需每场景数小时优化。
method: 为每张照片引入128维Photo Appearance Token和渲染图的逐通道缩放/偏移共6参数变换，用小MLP由该令牌和逐高斯特征预测颜色以替代球谐颜色；同一变换也用于致密化与剪枝时的渲染评分，避免把照片间外观差异误计为重建误差。
result: 在PhotoTourism上每场景训练8.8分钟，LPIPS为对比方法最低，比LPIPS次优的AsymGS快23倍；在NeRF-OSR上每场景9.7分钟，平均PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS均为对比方法最佳。
conclusion: 表明紧凑的逐图像外观适配可在分钟级完成野外高斯泼溅训练，并在多个指标上优于或媲美现有方法；通过解耦照片外观与几何/光度评分，为互联网照片的三维重建与新视角合成提供高效方案。

title: Marrying Capacity and Precision for Efficient 2D Gaussian Image Representation
abstract: 2D Gaussian representations provide an explicit and efficient way to represent images, but their rate-distortion performance under limited budgets depends critically on how Gaussian capacity and parameter precision are allocated. Existing methods typically optimize these two resources separately, overlooking content-dependent capacity demands and heterogeneous quantization sensitivity. We present CP-GS, a capacity-precision coupled Gaussian splatting framework for budget-aware 2D Gaussian image representation that jointly optimizes capacity allocation and attribute precision under a shared rate constraint. CP-GS first constructs a content-adaptive Gaussian representation by dynamically reallocating a fixed Gaussian budget from redundant regions to areas with higher representation demand.
